The Pangilatan Peak Loop is a 5.26 km loop hike located across Inayagan and Cantao-an in Naga City. I followed a route that began high on the mountain, descended toward the Metro Cebu Expressway, and circled back up past several rural communities to reach the peak. <\/p>\n\n\n\n

The hike was characterized by a long, steep initial descent over fine scree and sharp rock, followed by road walking through active construction areas and local settlements. A morning haze hung across the valley during this sunny hike, which I completed in August 2026.<\/p>\n\n\n
